SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAR-08-2022 - CONTINUED FOR PROOF OF SERVICE TO APR-26-2022 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF ARUN LUTHRA IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT GEICO GENERAL INSURANCE COMPANY IS NOT PRESENT. DEFENDANTS ZOOM REQUEST WAS DENIED AS UNTIMLY. PLAINTIFF SHOWS THE COURT A PHOTO (ON CELL PHONE) OF A PROOF OF SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF CLAIMS BUT WAS NOT TIMELY FILED WITH THE COURT PRIOR TO TODAY' HEARING. PLAINTIFF IS INSTRUCTED THAT HE WILL NEED TO RE-SERVE PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM ON DEFENDANT. DEFENDANTS PREVIOUSLY SUBMITTED EXHIBITS ARE RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: MICHAEL MAU; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED. (506)
ORDER RE: CONTINUANCE FOR PROOF OF SERVICE. (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT)

DECLARATION OF APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OF CORPORATION PURSUANT TO CCP 116.540 (B)-(H) FILED BY DEFENDANT GEICO GENERAL INSURANCE COMPANY
STIPULATION TO ALLOW THE CASE TO BE HEARD BY A JUDGE PRO TEM. FILED BY LUTHRA, ARUN GEICO GENERAL INSURANCE COMPANY

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF APR-26-2022 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF APR-26-2022 BY JUDGE PRO TEM. PLAINTIFF ARUN LUTHRA IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT GEICO GENERAL INSURANCE COMPANY IS PRESENT REPRESENTED BY KAREN GOLDSTEIN, CLAIM'S ADJUSTER. PROOF OF SERVICE ON FILE. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF APR-26-2022 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF LUTHRA, ARUN IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT GEICO GENERAL INSURANCE COMPANY DEFENDANT MOTION FOR DISMISSAL SO THAT PLAINTIFF CAN REFILE SUIT AGAINST THEIR INSURED DRIVER IS GRANTED. CASE IS DISMISSED WITHOUT PREJUDICE. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
